topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I was so certain this idea was mine alone, a spark of innovation nestled quietly within my thoughts, waiting for the moment to shine. After countless nights and cups of coffee, I finally pieced everything together, excited to see the world through a new lens. But then, diving into the abyss of patent databases, the cold truth surfaced—a parallel mind, unknown to me, had already wandered the same path and claimed its territory. My heart sank, the weight of this discovery pressing down, making the air around me feel thick and unbreathable. I stare at my mock-ups, my sketches, and wonder if all the effort, all the belief, was just a mirage.
